Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git, "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"and sub-agent pages."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-better-sidebar"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A dual workbench for DSH: native right sidebar + self-drawn bottom panel, with the ctx.betterSidebar"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" service open to every plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🌏 中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| **🗂️ File Management**
Lazy-loading tree, git status colors, live directory watch, global search, "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"drag-and-drop upload, multi-select batch actions, dual-source "Open with" menu."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| **🌿 Git**
Source Control (Merge / Staged / Changes groups, message box with Generate, branch + syn"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"c footer) plus a this-session AI-changes lens, with a **read-only commit graph** (lanes, branch and "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tag badges, branch filter, commit details) in one tab."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **📝 Editable Editor & Previews**
An editable CodeMirror (the stock preview is read-only), Markdown"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" + Mermaid + floating outline, sandboxed HTML preview, `.jsonl` record cards, paged preview for huge"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" files, streaming transfers with no size caps.
| **🧩 Tasks**
Live subagent topology (workflow graph "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"/ tree modes) + background task list: exit codes, live output, force-kill."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| **💬 Side Chat (beta)**
Codex-style side threads: inherit the full parent context and run independe"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ntly, realtime push, visible & revocable queue, per-thread model selection, one-click promotion to a"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" top-level session.
| **🖥️ Bottom Workbench**
A self-drawn bottom panel that coexists with the nativ"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"e right sidebar: drag-to-split panes, multiple terminal tabs, per-session persisted layout."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Also**: 📂 the `sidebar_open` tool lets the model open the sidebar itself · ⚡ ~325KB core at startu"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"p, heavy chunks load on demand · 🌏 i18n follows DSH · 📱 narrow screens switch to a full-width drawer"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 🌿 Git Graph (read-only commit graph)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Switch to **Git Graph** at the top of the Git panel for commit nodes, forks and merge edges across l"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ocal branches, remote-tracking branches and HEAD. The branch selector only filters history — it **ne"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ver checks out or fetches**; each commit is one line (lane edges + ref pills + subject), hover shows"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" the author and short hash, and selecting one opens its full message and diff in the bottom pane. Hi"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"story loads in pages; reference changes during pagination prompt a refresh; reads are bounded (200 c"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ommits per page, offset 10,000, 1,000 branches) and report an explicit error past a limit. Lightweig"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ht and annotated tags appear on commits in the graph, rows and details use neutral tag pills, and ta"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"g changes invalidate pagination. Tag decorations keep the first 5,000 tags by ref name, further boun"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ded by an 8 MiB complete-line output prefix; excess tags are omitted without failing the graph."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 🧭 dsh-context diagnostics (optional)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"With the `dsh-context` plugin installed, three places offer a one-click jump into that conversation'"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s **Context** view: an agent node's detail card on the Tasks page, a background job's output window "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"(the job's real owner session — never merely the session its row was watched under), and the session"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" header. The entries **appear only** while dsh-context's `Context` page is actually registered: a de"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ployment without it (or with that page hidden) shows no control at all, and while one jump is in fli"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ght every entry point is disabled. A failed jump is reported once, in a dismissible alert at the fra"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"me's bottom edge; nothing is polled while idle."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 🚀 Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then **hard-refresh the browser** (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R).
